The '''Temple of Eedit''', also known as the '''Eedit Temple''', was a temple of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was located on the jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. The temple had two towers that borrowed the architectural styles of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. A hub of [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] in the [[Devaron system/Legends|Devaron system]], the facility was built around a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

It was used as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] base during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:RopalAndDevaronians-TCWs02i01p01.png|thumb|left|200px|Ropal speaks with [[Unidentified male Devaronian minister|Devaronian]] [[Unidentified female Devaronian minister|ministers]] at the temple.]]
Erected by the Jedi Order to serve as a base for training, due to the region's dense population of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], the Temple was small compared to others across the galaxy. Constructed near the city of [[Tikaroo/Legends|Tikaroo]] over top of a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Temple was surrounded on all sides by dense jungle that thrived off of the Force nexus' power. The vergence itself assisted in the learning of new healing skills and promoted self-renewal.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Temple was used as a military base and surveillance post for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army's]] operations in the region. Construction of the Republic outpost was initially overseen by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] until a [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Separatist assault]] on the base drove him offworld.<ref name="CoD">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> Later, around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces [[Devaron massacre/Legends|invaded]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] to destroy the temple. Though the Temple's caretaker [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Knox/Legends|Knox]], alongside [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Trauma/Legends|Trauma]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]], defended the temple from the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] new apprentice [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] suddenly appeared in the midst of the battle and took out all Republic forces, including the two Jedi. At the end of battle, no [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], or Jedi survived, only Opress.<ref name="Monster" />

The [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] investigated the outpost and brought back the bodies of Halsey and Knox to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref> After the assault, the Temple fell out of use, and the locals began avoiding the site. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] at the end of the Clone Wars, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] bombed the Temple and destroyed anything with Jedi symbolism, toppling statues and burning records. The top of the main tower was targeted, and rubble from its collapse blocked the main entrance. The Imperials left a crater in the main hall, evidence of a targeted demolition on something that once sat at its center. The jungle began to advance on the courtyard, held back by the power of the vergence, which attracted [[Pikhron/Legends|pikhrons]] to the circular area.<ref name="NoP" />

==Layout==
Consisting of two dissimilar gray towers connected at their base, the central tower's upper sections were adorned by three decorative fins similar to the Coruscant Jedi Temple. The base of the tower was dominated by the main hall. The upper floors contained the caretaker's offices, dining halls, classrooms. The towers were surrounded by low-lying residences and greenhouses and fronted by a circular courtyard used for group meditation and training exercises. During the Clone Wars, communications arrays and dishes were installed to serve as a Republic listening post. In the wake of the Imperial bombing, an underground security tunnel was left exposed and the main entrance collapsed. Many of the statues that dotted the campus were defaced and the pinnacle chambers of the main tower were caved in.<ref name="Monster" />
